advisories.issue: Zone-level tile_types remap gap: validate_wall_law! binds registry types' own chars, and validate_map! checks existence + palette refs only — a zone could remap a WALL_CHARS char (e.g. '%') to a floor-passability type. Sim stays safe (grid-char law still blocks), but wall_ref then falls back to :wall, and if that zone's palette ALSO omits :wall the renderer/map_artifact draw a nil color at frame time with no load-time refusal (TileMap requires no palette keys).
advisories.suggestion: Extend validate_map! to refuse tile_types entries whose key is in TileMap::WALL_CHARS but whose type passability != 'wall' (and the reverse: a passability-'wall' type remapped onto a non-blocking char is silently walkable and floor-rendered). One loop, same refusal register.

advisories.issue: tools/build_district_v2b.py carries its own hardcoded char and INT maps ({'#':1,...,'~':6}, no '%'/7) — reusing it to regenerate district or author future floors cannot emit the second wall class and silently votes '%'-free grids.
advisories.suggestion: When next touched, derive its char/int_grid maps from data/tiles.json instead of literals (registry-driven like the importer), or add '%':7 alongside.

advisories.issue: The 'existing zones render byte-identically' claim is gated on 2 canaries (world_loop, floor1_run) + the fixture + the map surface; the other ~35 wall scripts ride the by-construction argument ('#' resolves :wall, merge groups by ref) — sound, but unswept.
advisories.suggestion: Run a detached harness/run_wall.sh sweep at the next natural point (per the 'wall owed when visual surfaces move' law) rather than before this push; the construction proof plus 20/20 identical frames justifies shipping now.

advisories.issue: Station fill fallback chain (renderer ~603, map_artifact ~80: palette[key] || :station || :wall) left untouched — agreed correct: both surfaces share the identical chain so they cannot disagree; but in a future wall_inner-heavy zone lacking station palette keys, stations will paint boundary-black next to red walls.
advisories.suggestion: No code change owed; note it in the lane-D authoring guidance (zones using wall_inner should carry their station palette refs).

advisories.issue: Crossing.validated_arrivals does not dedupe: district's arrival list now carries [1,13] three times (grass_fixture + nest + wall_fixture). Today's only order/count-sensitive consumers are the gate-field anchor (district declares gradient_anchor — trap checked) and Aggro's idempotent .any? distance probe, so it is inert.
advisories.suggestion: If a future consumer ever counts or weights arrival tiles, dedupe in validated_arrivals first; consider arrivals[t[:to]] << spawn unless already present.
